gu.This soft-noodle, light-gravy Chinese ch: આ નરમ નૂડલ્સ અને હળવા રસાવાળી ચાઇનીઝ ચોપ્સી મૂળ યાદીના વર્ણન મુજબ છે; લાલ મીઠી-ખાટી અમેરિકન ચોપ્સી કે કરકરા નૂડલ્સથી જુદી છે. કોર્નસ્ટાર્ચનો કાચો સ્વાદ દૂર કરવા થોડું ઉકાળો. માછલી કે ઓયસ્ટર અર્ક વગરનો હળવો શાકાહારી સોયા સોસ લો.

recipe.name: Vegetables in Black Bean Sauce
steps: Rinse the jasmine rice. Put it in a lidded saucepan with 420 ml of the measured water, bring to a boil, cover and cook over the lowest heat for 12 minutes. Turn off the heat and rest covered for 10 minutes before fluffing. Cut broccoli into small florets, pepper and onion into bite-size pieces, baby corn in halves, mushrooms into slices, and trim the snow peas.

Rinse the fermented black soybeans briefly and drain; roughly chop half so their flavor spreads while the other half remain visible. These are salty fermented Chinese soybeans, not ordinary cooked black beans or Korean chunjang paste. Mince garlic and ginger. Whisk the remaining 250 ml water, soy sauce, rice vinegar, cornstarch and sugar until smooth.

Heat 25 ml oil in a wide wok over medium-high heat. Stir-fry broccoli and baby corn for 3 minutes, then add onion, mushrooms and bell pepper for 2 minutes. Add snow peas and stir-fry another 1 minute. Move the vegetables to a plate while still bright and slightly crisp so they do not overcook in the sauce.

Add the remaining 15 ml oil to the hot wok. Stir garlic, ginger and the chopped and whole fermented black beans for 30–45 seconds until fragrant without burning. Stir the prepared liquid again to lift the settled starch, pour it in and simmer for 1–2 minutes until glossy and lightly thickened. Taste before adding any salt; the beans and soy sauce are already salty.

Return all vegetables to the wok and toss for 1 minute until hot and evenly coated, with distinct black-bean flecks still visible. Divide the stir-fry among four bowls and serve with the fluffy jasmine rice separately, as in the photograph.
tips: Use fermented Chinese black soybeans (douchi), not canned black kidney beans and not Korean black-bean noodle paste. Rinsing moderates their saltiness. The vegetables should stay crisp-tender and the sauce glossy rather than becoming a thick black puree.

recipe.name: White Sauce Pasta
steps: Check the penne is made eggless. Bring the 2500 ml water and 8 g of the salt to a rolling boil. Cook pasta to the packet's al dente time, stirring early to prevent sticking. Drain well but do not rinse. Meanwhile dice the carrot, bell pepper and onion into small even pieces, and mince garlic.

Heat olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Cook onion and carrot for 3 minutes, then add peas, sweet corn and bell pepper for another 3 minutes until the vegetables are just tender and still colorful. Add garlic for the final 30 seconds. Move the vegetables to a plate so they do not soften too much in the sauce.

Warm the milk separately until just lukewarm. In the cleaned pan melt butter over low heat. Stir in flour and cook for 2 minutes while whisking, until it smells lightly nutty but stays pale; do not brown the roux. Gradually add the milk in 4–5 additions, whisking smooth after each one to prevent lumps.

Cook the white sauce over medium-low heat for 4–5 minutes, stirring the base of the pan, until it coats a spoon but still flows. Season with the remaining 4 g salt, black pepper, oregano and nutmeg. If lumps form, whisk firmly off the heat before returning to a gentle simmer.

Return the vegetables and drained penne to the sauce. Fold gently over low heat for 1–2 minutes until the sauce coats every tube and everything is hot. Divide into four bowls and serve immediately; the sauce thickens as it sits.
tips: The photograph shows penne, carrots, peas, sweet corn and red pepper in a béchamel-style white sauce. Keep the flour pale for a clean ivory color. Cheese is not needed; if added separately, choose cheese made with vegetarian rennet.

gu.Cook the white sauce over medium-low hea: વ્હાઇટ સોસને મધ્યમ-ધીમા તાપે 4–5 મિનિટ કડાઈનું તળિયું હલાવતા રાંધો જેથી ચમચી પર ચડે છતાં વહેતો રહે. બાકીનું 4 ગ્રામ મીઠું, કાળી મરી, ઓરેગાનો અને જાયફળ ભેળવો. ગાંઠ થાય તો તાપ પરથી ઉતારી જોરથી ફેંટો, પછી ધીમે ઉકાળો.
gu.Return the vegetables and drained penne: શાક અને નિતારેલો પેને સોસમાં પાછા નાખો. ધીમા તાપે 1–2 મિનિટ હળવેથી ભેળવો જેથી દરેક પાસ્તા પર સોસ ચડે અને બધું ગરમ થાય. ચાર વાટકામાં વહેંચી તરત પીરસો; રાખવાથી સોસ વધુ ઘટ્ટ થાય છે.
gu.The photograph shows penne, carrots, pea: ફોટામાં પેને, ગાજર, વટાણા, મીઠી મકાઈ અને લાલ મરચું બેશામેલ જેવી સફેદ સોસમાં છે. હળવા રંગ માટે મેંદો બદામી ન કરો. ચીઝ જરૂરી નથી; અલગથી નાખો તો શાકાહારી રેનેટવાળી ચીઝ પસંદ કરો.

recipe.name: Pesto Pasta
steps: Check the fusilli is eggless and the hard cheese is explicitly made with vegetarian coagulants; traditional Parmesan is not suitable. Pick and wash the basil leaves, then dry them completely so the pesto does not turn watery. Peel and roughly chop garlic. Set aside a few small basil leaves for finishing.

Toast the pine nuts in a dry pan over low-medium heat for 2–3 minutes, shaking often, until lightly golden, not dark. Cool, then reserve 15 g for garnish. Finely grate the cheese and reserve 10 g for garnish. Put the remaining 55 g nuts, 60 g cheese, garlic and 4 g salt into a processor and pulse to coarse crumbs.

Add most of the basil and pulse briefly, scraping the sides. Stream in the olive oil and lemon juice while pulsing just until a textured green sauce forms. Avoid a long continuous blend, which heats and darkens the basil. Keep the pesto at room temperature while the pasta cooks.

Bring 2500 ml water and the remaining 8 g salt to a rolling boil. Add fusilli and cook to the packet's al dente time, stirring at the start. Before draining, scoop out about 80 ml of the starchy pasta water. Drain the pasta well without rinsing.

Put the hot fusilli in a large warm bowl off the heat. Add pesto and toss gently, adding the reserved pasta water a little at a time until the sauce coats the twists without pooling. Divide into four bowls and top with reserved pine nuts, cheese and basil leaves. Serve immediately; do not boil the pesto after mixing.
tips: Pine nuts are a major allergen. This fresh basil pesto uses vegetarian hard cheese in place of animal-rennet Parmesan. A splash of starchy pasta water makes the pesto cling without cream; keep the finished sauce off direct heat to preserve its green color.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।

recipe.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Check the spaghetti is eggless. Bring 2400 ml water with 10 g salt to a rolling boil in a wide pot. Add spaghetti, stir to separate the strands and cook for about 1 minute less than the packet's al dente time; it will finish in the pan. Meanwhile peel garlic and cut it into thin, even slices. Finely chop the parsley leaves.

When the pasta is almost ready, heat 80 ml olive oil in a wide pan over low-medium heat. Add garlic slices and cook slowly for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until only pale golden and fragrant. Add chilli flakes for the final 20 seconds. Do not let the garlic turn dark brown or the oil will taste bitter.

Before draining, scoop out about 200 ml of the starchy pasta cooking water. Lift the spaghetti into the garlic pan with tongs; a little clinging water is useful. Raise the heat to medium and add 100 ml reserved pasta water. Toss and shake the pan vigorously for 1–2 minutes so the oil and water form a light glossy coating instead of separating.

Add more reserved pasta water a spoonful at a time, up to the remaining 100 ml, only if the strands look dry. Cook until the spaghetti is just tender and no watery puddle remains. Taste and add the remaining 2 g salt only if needed; pasta water already carries salt.

Turn off the heat and fold in chopped parsley. Divide the spaghetti, garlic slices and chilli evenly among four warm plates and serve immediately while the light olive-oil emulsion still clings to the strands.
tips: This is a simple garlic, olive oil and chilli pasta with no cheese or fish. The pasta water is the key to a glossy sauce rather than an oily pool. Keep the garlic pale gold; burnt garlic makes the entire dish bitter.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Masala Pasta
steps: Check that the dry penne is eggless. Boil 2200 ml water with 8 g salt in a large pot. Add the pasta, stir well and cook until just al dente, following the packet time. Reserve 150 ml cooking water, then drain the pasta without rinsing it. Meanwhile finely chop the onion, tomatoes, ginger, garlic and chilli; dice the bell pepper and carrot into small, even pieces.

Heat 30 ml oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until softened and lightly golden. Add ginger, garlic and green chilli; stir for 1 minute until fragrant. Add diced carrot and peas with 50 ml reserved pasta water, cover and cook for 4 minutes until the carrot starts to soften.

Stir in turmeric, chilli powder and coriander powder for 20 seconds. Add chopped tomatoes and tomato paste. Cook uncovered for 7–9 minutes, stirring and pressing the tomatoes, until they break down into a thick, cohesive masala and the raw tomato smell fades. Add the bell pepper and cook for 2 minutes so it stays slightly crisp.

Fold the drained penne into the masala with 50–100 ml reserved pasta water, adding only enough to coat every piece without making the sauce watery. Add garam masala and the remaining 4 g salt, then simmer together for 2 minutes. Taste and adjust seasoning; the finished pasta should be moist and well coated, not swimming in sauce.
Turn off the heat, scatter chopped coriander leaves over the pasta and serve hot in four bowls. Divide the visible peas, carrot and bell pepper evenly among the servings.
tips: The reviewed dish photo shows red onion-tomato masala clinging to penne with peas, green bell pepper, carrot and coriander. Keep this as a savory Indian masala pasta, without cream or cheese. Reserve pasta water before draining so the masala coats the pasta evenly.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Chilli Garlic Noodles
steps: Check that the dry Hakka noodles contain eggless. Bring 2200 ml water with 6 g salt to a full boil. Cook the noodles according to their packet until just tender, usually 4–6 minutes; stir once or twice to separate them. Drain immediately, rinse briefly with cool water to halt cooking, and toss with 5 ml of the oil so the strands stay separate.

Finely mince the garlic. Slice carrot and both bell peppers into thin matchsticks. Separate the spring onion whites from the greens; thinly slice both. Mix the soy sauce, vegetarian red chilli sauce and vinegar in a small bowl so they can go into the wok together.

Heat the remaining 30 ml oil in a large wok or wide pan over medium-high heat. Add garlic and spring onion whites and stir-fry for 30–40 seconds until fragrant but not dark. Add chilli flakes for 10 seconds, then add carrot and both peppers. Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes, keeping the vegetables slightly crisp.

Pour in the mixed sauces and toss for 20 seconds. Add the drained noodles, lift and toss for 1–2 minutes so the sauce and garlic coat every strand and the noodles are hot. Taste before adding the remaining 2 g salt because soy sauce varies in saltiness. If the pan is too dry, add 15–30 ml hot water, not extra sauce.

Turn off the heat. Fold in the spring onion greens, scatter toasted sesame seeds over the noodles and divide into four bowls. Serve at once while the noodles remain springy and the vegetables retain their colour.
tips: The reviewed image shows glossy separated noodles with browned minced garlic, red and green pepper strips, carrot, spring onion and sesame. This is a dry stir-fried dish, not a gravy noodle bowl. Check the chilli sauce and noodles are vegetarian and eggless.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.eggless dry Hakka noodles: बिना अंडे के सूखे हक्का नूडल्स

recipe.name: Schezwan Noodles
steps: Check that the Hakka noodles contain eggless and the Schezwan sauce is vegetarian. Bring 2200 ml water and 6 g salt to a rolling boil. Cook the noodles to just tender according to the packet, usually 4–6 minutes. Drain, rinse briefly with cool water to stop cooking, and toss with 5 ml oil so the strands separate.

Mince garlic and ginger. Thinly shred cabbage, carrot and both bell peppers. Slice spring onions, keeping the white and green parts separate. Set the measured Schezwan sauce, soy sauce and vinegar beside the stove; stir-frying moves quickly.

Heat the remaining 30 ml oil in a wide wok over medium-high heat. Stir-fry the garlic, ginger and spring onion whites for 30 seconds without burning them. Add carrot, cabbage and peppers; toss briskly for 3–4 minutes until the edges soften while the vegetables still have colour and a little crunch.

Reduce heat to medium. Add the Schezwan sauce and soy sauce and stir for 30 seconds to distribute the chilli-garlic paste. Add noodles in two handfuls and toss for 1–2 minutes until evenly coated and hot. Add the vinegar and toss once more. Taste before adding up to the remaining 2 g salt; both prepared sauces may already be salty. If necessary, loosen with 15–30 ml hot water rather than making it soupy.

Turn off the heat and fold in the spring onion greens. Divide the vivid red noodles and vegetables evenly between four bowls and serve immediately, while the noodles are springy and the vegetables are still lightly crisp.
tips: The reviewed photo shows a spicy red Schezwan coating with cabbage, carrots, red and green pepper and spring onion. Schezwan sauce is the defining ingredient here; plain chilli garlic noodles are a separate dish. The finished noodles should be glossy and dry, with no pool of sauce.

recipe.name: Cacio e Pepe

ingredients.name: vegetarian Pecorino-style hard cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Check that the dry spaghetti contains eggless. Check the cheese label for vegetarian coagulants; standard Pecorino often contains animal-derived coagulants. Finely grate 150 g cheese, reserving 20 g for finishing. Crush the peppercorns coarsely just before cooking.

Bring 1800 ml water and 8 g salt to a boil in a wide pot so the cooking water becomes starchy. Add spaghetti and stir to separate. Cook about 1 minute less than the packet's al dente time. Before draining, reserve 400 ml of the hot, cloudy cooking water.

While the pasta cooks, toast 6 g crushed pepper in a wide dry pan over medium-low heat for 30–45 seconds until fragrant. Add 150 ml reserved pasta water and simmer for 1 minute. Transfer the almost-cooked spaghetti to this pan with tongs; toss for 1–2 minutes so it finishes in the peppery water. Remove the pan from the heat.

Let the pan and pasta cool for about 45 seconds to prevent the cheese clumping. In a bowl, whisk the 130 g grated cheese with 70–90 ml warm, not boiling, reserved pasta water into a smooth thick cream. Pour it over the pasta off the heat and toss vigorously for 1 minute. Add more warm pasta water a tablespoon at a time until a silky sauce coats each strand; never boil after adding cheese.
Divide at once into four warm shallow bowls. Sprinkle with the reserved 20 g cheese and remaining 2 g crushed pepper. Serve immediately, before the cheese emulsion tightens as it cools.
tips: The reviewed photo shows a pale glossy cheese coating and generous cracked black pepper, without cream, butter or vegetables. Only use hard cheese explicitly made with vegetarian or microbial rennet. Off-heat mixing and starchy water make the smooth sauce.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Spaghetti Pomodoro
steps: Check that the dry spaghetti is eggless. Score a shallow cross on each tomato base. Dip the tomatoes into boiling water for 45–60 seconds, then into cool water; peel and chop them, removing hard cores. Peel and lightly crush the garlic cloves. Tear the basil leaves by hand and keep a few for serving.

Warm 40 ml olive oil and the crushed garlic in a wide pan over low heat for 2–3 minutes until fragrant but not brown. Add the chopped tomatoes and 4 g salt. Simmer uncovered for 15–20 minutes, stirring and pressing the tomatoes, until they collapse into a bright sauce that lightly holds on a spoon. Remove the garlic if you prefer a smooth sauce.

While the sauce simmers, boil 2500 ml water with 10 g salt. Cook the spaghetti to about 1 minute less than the packet's al dente time. Before draining, reserve 200 ml cloudy pasta water. Transfer the pasta directly into the tomato pan; do not rinse.

Add 80 ml reserved pasta water and toss the spaghetti with the sauce over medium heat for 1–2 minutes. Add a little more water only if needed so the tomato and olive oil form a glossy coating rather than a pool. Turn off the heat and fold in most of the torn basil and the remaining 10 ml olive oil.
Taste and adjust only if needed; the salted pasta water is already seasoned. Divide into four warm bowls, distribute the tomato sauce evenly, top with the remaining basil and serve immediately.
tips: The reviewed photo shows simple red tomato-coated spaghetti with basil and no cheese. Ripe tomatoes, gentle garlic and a final toss with starchy pasta water provide the fresh pomodoro flavour and sheen. If the tomatoes are watery, reduce the sauce before adding pasta.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
સૂકી સ્પાઘેટીમાં ઇંડું ન હોય તે તપાસો. દરેક ટામેટાંના તળિયે છીછરો ક્રોસ કાપો. ટામેટાંને 45–60 સેકંડ ઉકળતા પાણીમાં, પછી ઠંડા પાણીમાં મૂકો; છાલ ઉતારી સમારો અને કઠણ ડીંટાવાળો ભાગ કાઢો. લસણ છોલી સહેજ ખાંડો. બેસિલનાં પાન હાથથી તોડો અને થોડાં ઉપર મૂકવા રાખો.
gu.Warm 40 ml olive oil and the crushed gar: પહોળી કડાઈમાં 40 મિલી ઓલિવ તેલ અને ખાંડેલું લસણ ધીમા તાપે 2–3 મિનિટ સુગંધ આવે ત્યાં સુધી ગરમ કરો, બદામી ન કરો. સમારેલા ટામેટાં અને 4 ગ્રામ મીઠું નાખો. ઢાંક્યા વગર 15–20 મિનિટ હલાવતા અને ટામેટાં દબાવતા રાંધો જેથી ચમકતી સોસ ચમચા પર સહેજ ચોંટે. સુંવાળી સોસ જોઈએ તો લસણ કાઢો.
gu.While the sauce simmers, boil 2500 ml wa: સોસ રંધાય ત્યારે 2500 મિલી પાણીમાં 10 ગ્રામ મીઠું નાખી ઉકાળો. સ્પાઘેટી પેકેટના અલ દંતે સમય કરતાં આશરે 1 મિનિટ ઓછી રાંધો. નિતારતાં પહેલાં 200 મિલી ધૂંધળું પાસ્તાનું પાણી સાચવો. પાસ્તા સીધા ટામેટાંવાળી કડાઈમાં નાખો; ધોશો નહીં.
gu.Add 80 ml reserved pasta water and toss: 80 મિલી સાચવેલું પાસ્તાનું પાણી નાખી સ્પાઘેટીને સોસમાં મધ્યમ તાપે 1–2 મિનિટ ઉછાળો. જરૂર હોય તો થોડું વધુ પાણી નાખો જેથી ટામેટાં અને ઓલિવ તેલ ચમકદાર પડ બનાવે, નીચે રસ ભેગો ન થાય. તાપ બંધ કરી મોટા ભાગનાં તોડેલાં બેસિલ પાન અને બાકીનું 10 મિલી ઓલિવ તેલ ભેળવો.
gu.Taste and adjust only if needed; the sal: ચાખીને જરૂર હોય તો જ સ્વાદ ગોઠવો; મીઠાવાળા પાસ્તાના પાણીથી સ્વાદ આવી ગયો છે. ચાર ગરમ વાટકામાં વહેંચો, ટામેટાંની સોસ સરખી આપો, બાકીનું બેસિલ ઉપર મૂકો અને તરત પીરસો.
gu.The reviewed photo shows simple red toma: તપાસેલા ફોટામાં બેસિલ સાથે સાદી લાલ ટામેટાંવાળી સ્પાઘેટી છે, ચીઝ નથી. પાકાં ટામેટાં, ધીમે રાંધેલું લસણ અને સ્ટાર્ચવાળા પાસ્તાના પાણીમાં છેલ્લે ઉછાળવાથી તાજો સ્વાદ અને ચમક મળે છે. ટામેટાં પાણી વધારે છોડે તો પાસ્તા ઉમેરતાં પહેલાં સોસ ઘટ્ટ કરો.

recipe.name: Pasta alla Norma
steps: Check that the rigatoni contains eggless and the cheese label confirms vegetarian coagulants. Cut the eggplant into 2 cm cubes, leaving the purple skin on. Chop the tomatoes, mince the garlic and tear the basil leaves. Pat the eggplant dry so it browns instead of steaming.

Heat 45 ml olive oil in a large wide pan over medium-high heat. Cook the eggplant in two batches for 8–10 minutes each, turning occasionally, until golden with soft centres and some browned edges. Do not crowd the pan. Transfer to a plate and sprinkle with 2 g salt.

Lower the heat to medium and add 15 ml olive oil to the same pan. Cook garlic for 30 seconds without browning. Add chopped tomatoes, 4 g salt and black pepper. Simmer uncovered for 12–15 minutes, stirring and pressing the tomatoes, until thick and no longer raw-tasting. Fold two-thirds of the browned eggplant and most basil into the sauce; keep the best pieces and a few leaves for topping.

Meanwhile boil 2400 ml water with 8 g salt. Cook rigatoni according to the packet until just al dente. Reserve 150 ml cloudy pasta water and drain the pasta. Add rigatoni to the tomato-eggplant sauce with 60–100 ml reserved water; toss over medium heat for 1–2 minutes until every tube is coated, adding more water only if dry.

Divide among four warm bowls. Top evenly with the reserved golden eggplant, grated vegetarian ricotta salata-style cheese, remaining basil and final 5 ml olive oil. Serve immediately while the eggplant is tender and the sauce clings to the pasta.
tips: The reviewed image shows ridged short pasta, prominently browned eggplant, bright tomato, basil and a small amount of white cheese. Browning the eggplant in batches is essential. Use only cheese confirmed free of animal rennet; ordinary hard grating cheese is not automatically vegetarian.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.Check that the rigatoni contains eggless: जाँचें कि रिगाटोनी में अंडा न हो और चीज़ के लेबल पर शाकाहारी या सूक्ष्मजीवी रेननेट लिखा हो। बैंगन को बैंगनी छिलके सहित 2 सेमी टुकड़ों में काटें। टमाटर काटें, लहसुन बारीक काटें और बेसिल पत्तियाँ तोड़ें। बैंगन सुखाएँ ताकि भाप में पकने के बजाय सुनहरा हो।
hi.Heat 45 ml olive oil in a large wide pan: बड़े चौड़े पैन में 45 मिली जैतून तेल मध्यम-तेज़ आँच पर गरम करें। बैंगन को दो हिस्सों में 8–10 मिनट प्रत्येक, बीच-बीच में पलटते हुए पकाएँ, जब तक बाहर सुनहरा और अंदर नरम हो तथा किनारे भूरे हों। पैन में भीड़ न करें। प्लेट पर निकालकर 2 ग्राम नमक छिड़कें।
hi.Lower the heat to medium and add 15 ml o: आँच मध्यम करें और उसी पैन में 15 मिली जैतून तेल डालें। लहसुन 30 सेकंड बिना भूरा किए पकाएँ। कटे टमाटर, 4 ग्राम नमक और काली मिर्च डालें। बिना ढके 12–15 मिनट चलाते और टमाटर दबाते पकाएँ, जब तक गाढ़ा और कच्चे स्वाद से मुक्त हो। भूने बैंगन के दो-तिहाई हिस्से और अधिकतर बेसिल सॉस में मिलाएँ; सुंदर टुकड़े और कुछ पत्तियाँ ऊपर रखने के लिए बचाएँ।
hi.Meanwhile boil 2400 ml water with 8 g sa: इस बीच 2400 मिली पानी और 8 ग्राम नमक उबालें। पैकेट के अनुसार रिगाटोनी बस अल दंते होने तक पकाएँ। 150 मिली धुंधला पास्ता पानी बचाकर पास्ता छानें। रिगाटोनी को टमाटर-बैंगन सॉस में 60–100 मिली बचा पानी डालकर मध्यम आँच पर 1–2 मिनट पलटें, जब तक हर ट्यूब पर सॉस चढ़े; सूखा लगे तभी और पानी डालें।
hi.Divide among four warm bowls. Top evenly: चार गरम कटोरियों में बाँटें। बचा सुनहरा बैंगन, कद्दूकस शाकाहारी रिकोटा सालाटा-जैसा चीज़, शेष बेसिल और अंतिम 5 मिली जैतून तेल बराबर ऊपर डालें। बैंगन नरम और सॉस पास्ता पर चिपकी हो तभी तुरंत परोसें।
hi.The reviewed image shows ridged short pa: समीक्षित तस्वीर में छोटे धारियों वाले पास्ता, स्पष्ट भूरे बैंगन, चमकीले टमाटर, बेसिल और थोड़ा सफेद चीज़ है। बैंगन को अलग-अलग हिस्सों में सुनहरा करना आवश्यक है। सिर्फ पशु रेननेट रहित चीज़ लें; आम कड़ा कद्दूकस वाला चीज़ अपने आप शाकाहारी नहीं होता।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.

recipe.name: Creamy Mushroom Pasta
steps: Check that the dry tagliatelle is eggless. Brush the mushrooms clean rather than soaking them, then slice evenly about 5 mm thick. Mince the garlic, strip the thyme leaves and chop the parsley. Keep the cream measured and ready, because the mushrooms brown quickly.

Bring 2300 ml water and 8 g salt to a rolling boil. Add the pasta, stir to separate and cook according to its packet until just al dente. Reserve 200 ml cloudy cooking water before draining. Do not rinse the pasta.

Meanwhile heat 20 ml olive oil and 15 g butter in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Add mushrooms in two batches so they can brown; leave each batch undisturbed for 2 minutes, then turn and cook about 4 minutes more until their water evaporates and edges deepen in colour. Return all mushrooms to the pan, add garlic and thyme, and stir for 45 seconds.

Lower heat to medium-low. Add the cream, remaining 10 g butter, 4 g salt and black pepper. Simmer gently for 2–3 minutes, stirring, until lightly thickened; do not boil hard or the cream may split. Add drained tagliatelle and 80 ml reserved pasta water. Toss for 1–2 minutes until a smooth sauce clings to the ribbons, adding more pasta water a spoonful at a time only if too thick.

Turn off the heat and fold in chopped parsley. Divide into four warm bowls and distribute the browned mushrooms evenly. Finish with a little more black pepper if desired and serve immediately while the sauce remains glossy.
tips: The reviewed photo shows ribbon pasta generously covered with visibly browned button mushrooms and a pale, clinging cream sauce flecked with thyme and parsley. Browning mushrooms before adding cream prevents a watery, grey sauce. No cheese is needed.

recipe.name: Lentil Bolognese
steps: Check that the spaghetti is eggless. Rinse the dry lentils and remove any stones. Simmer them in 900 ml water for 20–25 minutes until just tender but still holding their shape; drain any excess water. Finely dice onion, carrot and celery, mince garlic and tear basil leaves.

Heat 35 ml olive oil in a heavy wide pan over medium heat. Add onion, carrot and celery and cook for 8–10 minutes, stirring, until softened and lightly golden. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute. Stir in tomato paste and oregano for 1 minute to deepen their flavour without scorching.

Add tomato passata, the cooked lentils, 150 ml water, 5 g salt and black pepper. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook uncovered for 18–22 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thick and savoury but still moist. If it tightens before the carrot is soft, add some of the reserved 150 ml water. Fold in half the basil near the end; do not mash the lentils into a purée.

Meanwhile bring 2100 ml water and 8 g salt to a rolling boil. Cook spaghetti according to the packet until just al dente. Reserve 150 ml pasta water and drain. Toss the spaghetti into the sauce with 50–100 ml reserved pasta water for 1–2 minutes, so the tomato and lentils cling to the strands. Use more water only if the sauce is too thick.
Divide into four warm bowls. Spoon any remaining lentil sauce over the pasta, distribute the visible lentils and diced vegetables evenly, and finish with the remaining basil. Serve hot.
tips: The reviewed photo shows individual brown-green lentils in thick tomato sauce, small carrot and celery pieces and basil over spaghetti. Use green or brown lentils that retain their shape, not red lentils that dissolve. No meat, cheese or animal stock is included.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.dry green or brown lentils: સૂકી લીલી અથવા ભૂરી આખી મસૂર

dish.name: Pasta al Limone
ingredients: vegetarian hard grating cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

recipe.name: Pasta al Limone

ingredients.name: vegetarian hard grating cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Check that the dry spaghetti is eggless and the hard cheese is labelled vegetarian or microbial-coagulants. Wash and dry the lemons. Finely grate only the yellow zest, keeping a little for garnish; avoid bitter white pith. Squeeze and measure 45 ml juice, removing seeds. Finely grate the cheese and chop parsley.

Bring 2200 ml water and 8 g salt to a rolling boil. Add spaghetti, stir to separate and cook about 1 minute less than the packet's al dente time. Before draining, reserve at least 300 ml hot, cloudy pasta water.

While the pasta cooks, melt 50 g butter in a wide pan over low heat. Add most of the lemon zest and stir for 1 minute to perfume the butter without browning it. Add 120 ml reserved pasta water and the almost-cooked spaghetti. Raise to medium heat and toss for 1–2 minutes until the pasta is just tender and glossy.

Turn off the heat and let the pan cool for 30 seconds. Add the remaining 20 g cold butter, 45 ml lemon juice and 50 g finely grated cheese. Toss vigorously, adding warm reserved pasta water a tablespoon at a time, until a pale silky sauce coats every strand; do not boil the cheese. Taste and add up to 2 g remaining salt only if needed.
Divide into four warm bowls and finish with the remaining 20 g cheese, reserved lemon zest, parsley and black pepper. Serve at once; the lemon-butter emulsion thickens as it cools.
tips: The reviewed photo shows pale glossy spaghetti, lemon zest, a little grated cheese, parsley and a lemon wedge. Use lemon zest for aroma and measured juice for brightness, without cream. Cheese must be made with non-animal rennet.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

dish.name: Spaghetti alla Nerano
ingredients: vegetarian aged provolone-style cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

recipe.name: Spaghetti alla Nerano

ingredients.name: vegetarian aged provolone-style cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Check that the spaghetti is eggless and the aged provolone-style cheese is explicitly made with vegetarian coagulants. Thinly slice zucchini into 3–4 mm rounds and pat dry. Finely grate the cheese, tear the basil leaves and lightly crush the garlic.

Heat 60 ml olive oil in a wide pan over medium-high heat. Fry zucchini in three batches, turning once, for about 4–5 minutes per batch until the rounds are golden with browned edges but still flexible. Transfer to paper to drain and sprinkle with 2 g salt. Keep a few attractive rounds for topping.

Bring 2200 ml water and 8 g salt to a rolling boil. Cook spaghetti until about 1 minute short of the packet's al dente time. Reserve 350 ml cloudy pasta water. Meanwhile warm the remaining 20 ml olive oil and crushed garlic in the zucchini pan over low heat for 1 minute, then remove the garlic before it browns.

Add most of the fried zucchini, most basil and 120 ml reserved pasta water to the pan. Add the almost-cooked spaghetti and toss over medium heat for 1–2 minutes, crushing a few soft zucchini slices into the starchy water to build a light sauce. Turn off the heat and wait 30 seconds. Add 80 g grated cheese in handfuls while tossing vigorously; add warm pasta water a spoonful at a time until the sauce is creamy and clings to each strand, never boiling the cheese.

Taste and add the last 1 g salt only if needed because the cheese is salty. Divide among four warm bowls, then finish with reserved golden zucchini rounds, 20 g grated cheese, the remaining basil and black pepper. Serve immediately.
tips: The reviewed photo prominently shows golden zucchini rounds and basil over pale glossy spaghetti. This vegetarian adaptation uses microbial-rennet aged provolone-style cheese instead of assuming traditional Provolone del Monaco is vegetarian. The creaminess comes from zucchini, cheese and pasta water, not cream.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Pasta alla Checca

steps: Check that the dry rigatoni contains eggless and the mozzarella label confirms vegetarian coagulants. Halve the cherry tomatoes and put them with their juices in a large serving bowl. Mince the garlic very finely, tear most of the basil by hand and cut the drained mozzarella into 1–2 cm pieces.

Mix the raw tomatoes with garlic, 35 ml olive oil, 4 g salt, black pepper and the torn basil. Leave at room temperature for 15–20 minutes while the tomatoes release some juice and the basil perfumes the oil. Do not cook this sauce; its fresh character defines the dish.

Bring 2300 ml water and 8 g salt to a rolling boil. Cook the rigatoni according to the packet until just al dente. Reserve 100 ml cooking water, then drain well. Let the pasta stand for 1 minute so its heat will warm the tomatoes without boiling or melting the cheese completely.

Tip the warm rigatoni into the raw tomato bowl and toss gently for 1 minute. Add mozzarella pieces and the remaining 10 ml olive oil, then toss once more. Add 15–30 ml reserved pasta water only if the mixture seems too dry; the tomatoes should stay visibly fresh and juicy, not form a cooked red sauce.
Divide the pasta, tomato halves and mozzarella evenly among four bowls. Top with the remaining basil leaves and serve warm or at room temperature, soon after mixing.
tips: The reviewed image shows distinct raw cherry tomato halves, soft white mozzarella pieces and basil among short pasta tubes. This is a no-cook sauce, unlike spaghetti pomodoro. Drain the mozzarella well and use only a cheese confirmed vegetarian.

recipe.name: Polenta e Funghi

ingredients.name: vegetarian hard grating cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Check that the grated hard cheese is made with vegetarian coagulants. Bring 1250 ml water and 7 g salt to a boil in a heavy saucepan. Whisk in the coarse polenta in a slow stream to avoid lumps. Reduce to a very gentle simmer and cook for 35–40 minutes, stirring frequently and scraping the bottom, until the grains are tender and the mixture is thick but spoonable. Add a little hot water if it stiffens too soon.
While the polenta cooks, brush the mushrooms clean and slice thickly. Mince garlic, strip the thyme leaves and chop parsley. Heat 25 ml olive oil and 15 g butter in a wide pan over medium-high heat.

Brown mushrooms in two batches so they do not steam, leaving each batch undisturbed for 2 minutes before turning. Cook another 4–5 minutes until their released liquid has evaporated and the edges are deeply golden. Return all mushrooms to the pan, add garlic and thyme and cook 45 seconds. Add 4 g salt and black pepper, stir for 1 minute, then take off the heat; a little natural mushroom pan juice is welcome.

When the polenta grains are fully tender, turn off the heat and stir in the remaining 20 g butter and 30 g finely grated vegetarian cheese. Beat for 1 minute until glossy and creamy. The polenta should slowly spread when spooned into a bowl; loosen with a splash of hot water if needed.

Spoon the hot golden polenta into four shallow bowls. Pile the browned mushrooms and any pan juices over each portion. Sprinkle with chopped parsley, the remaining 15 g cheese and a little thyme. Serve immediately before the polenta sets.
tips: The reviewed image shows a clearly visible bed of soft yellow polenta topped with richly browned mushrooms, herbs and a small cheese garnish. Use coarse polenta for the stated simmer time; instant polenta needs its packet timing instead. Mushroom browning and loose spoonable polenta are the key textures.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

recipe.name: Pizza Marinara
steps: Mix flour and instant yeast in a large bowl. Add 300 ml of the water and mix until no dry flour remains. Dissolve 10 g salt in the remaining 20 ml water and knead it into the dough for 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and leave at room temperature for 90–120 minutes until noticeably expanded.

Divide the dough into four equal balls, about 205 g each. Cover and rest 30–45 minutes so the dough relaxes. While it rests, crush the peeled tomatoes by hand and drain any very watery liquid; season with 3 g salt. Thinly slice the garlic. Do not cook the tomato topping.

Place a pizza stone or sturdy upside-down baking tray in the oven and preheat at its highest safe setting, ideally 250–275°C, for at least 30 minutes. On a lightly floured surface, press one ball outward from the centre to about 25 cm, leaving a raised 1–2 cm rim. Do not roll the rim flat. Work with one pizza at a time.

Spread one-quarter of the crushed tomatoes thinly over the centre, leaving the rim bare. Add one-quarter of the garlic slices, oregano and olive oil. Slide onto the hot stone or tray and bake for 7–10 minutes, or until the base is cooked and the rim is puffed with browned spots. Home ovens vary: bake longer if the crust remains pale or doughy. Repeat with the remaining three balls and toppings.
Serve each pizza hot as soon as it leaves the oven. The surface should show red tomato, garlic, oregano and olive oil, with no cheese; this is the classic marinara topping.
tips: The reviewed image shows a blistered raised crust and a cheese-free red tomato topping with thin garlic slices and oregano. Marinara pizza contains no seafood despite its name. Preheating the baking surface thoroughly is essential to cook the base before the tomato makes it soggy.

dish.name: Quattro Formaggi Pizza
ingredients: vegetarian mozzarella made with vegetarian coagulants
vegetarian hard grating cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

recipe.name: Quattro Formaggi Pizza

ingredients.name: vegetarian mozzarella made with vegetarian coagulants
vegetarian hard grating cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Check the labels of all four cheeses separately: each must be made with vegetarian coagulants. Mix flour and yeast, then add 300 ml water and combine into a shaggy dough. Dissolve 10 g salt in the remaining 20 ml water and knead it into the dough for 8–10 minutes until smooth. Cover and rise at room temperature for 90–120 minutes until expanded.

Divide the dough into four equal balls, cover and rest 30–45 minutes. Drain and tear the mozzarella into small pieces; pat it dry to prevent watery pizza. Coarsely grate the fontina-style cheese, crumble the mild blue cheese and finely grate the hard cheese.

Put a pizza stone or sturdy upside-down baking tray in the oven and preheat at the highest safe setting, ideally 250–275°C, for at least 30 minutes. On a lightly floured surface, press one dough ball from the middle into a roughly 25 cm round, keeping a raised 1–2 cm rim. Do not flatten the rim with a rolling pin.

Brush one-quarter of the olive oil over the centre. Scatter one-quarter of the mozzarella and fontina-style cheese, then dot with one-quarter of the blue cheese, leaving some white cheese visibly distinct. Bake on the hot stone or tray for 7–10 minutes until the crust is browned, the base is cooked and cheese bubbles; repeat for the remaining three pizzas.

Sprinkle each hot pizza with one-quarter of the finely grated hard cheese and black pepper. Rest 1 minute before slicing. Serve warm; the four cheeses should make a pale, melted topping with a few blue-cheese pockets, without tomato sauce.
tips: The reviewed photo is a white pizza with bubbly melted cheese and small blue-veined patches, no tomato. Four distinct vegetarian cheeses recreate mozzarella stretch, fontina melt, mild blue tang and aged savouriness. Ordinary Parmesan, Gorgonzola and other named cheeses may use animal rennet, so verify every label rather than relying on the name.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

ingredients: roasted red bell pepper, drained and sliced
vegetarian mozzarella made with vegetarian coagulants, grated

recipe.name: Stromboli

ingredients.name: roasted red bell pepper, drained and sliced
vegetarian mozzarella made with vegetarian coagulants, grated

steps: Mix flour, yeast, water, salt and 15 ml olive oil into a dough. Knead for 8–10 minutes until smooth and elastic. Cover and leave in a warm place for 60–75 minutes until noticeably doubled. Check the mozzarella label to ensure it uses microbial or other vegetarian coagulants.

Meanwhile heat 5 ml olive oil in a wide pan. Cook the sliced mushrooms over medium-high heat for 5–7 minutes until their liquid evaporates and the edges brown. Add garlic and spinach; cook 2–3 minutes until the leaves wilt. Transfer to a sieve and cool completely, pressing out excess moisture. Pat the drained roasted pepper strips dry.

Heat the oven to 220°C and line a baking tray. Roll the risen dough on a lightly floured surface into a rectangle about 35 × 28 cm. Spread the thick tomato sauce thinly, leaving a 3 cm clear border. Scatter the dry mushroom-spinach mixture, roasted pepper and grated vegetarian mozzarella evenly over the sauce; keep the filling away from the edges.

Starting at a long edge, roll the dough tightly around the filling into one long cylinder. Pinch the seam and both ends firmly shut, then place seam-side down on the tray. Brush the outside with the remaining 5 ml olive oil, sprinkle with oregano and cut three shallow steam slits across the top.

Bake for 25–30 minutes until the crust is deep golden and fully cooked and the cheese bubbles through the slits. Rest on the tray for 10 minutes so the filling sets, then cut into thick diagonal slices. Serve warm, with extra tomato sauce on the side if desired.
tips: Cool and drain the cooked vegetables before rolling: wet filling makes the centre soggy and can split the crust. The reviewed image shows a sliced golden roll with visible spinach, mushrooms, red pepper, tomato and melted cheese.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

dish.name: Panzerotti
ingredients: vegetarian mozzarella made with vegetarian coagulants

recipe.name: Panzerotti

ingredients.name: vegetarian mozzarella made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Mix flour, yeast and 240 ml lukewarm water, then add salt and olive oil. Knead for 8–10 minutes until smooth and springy. Cover and rise for 60–75 minutes until doubled. Check the mozzarella label for microbial or other vegetarian coagulants.

While the dough rises, simmer the tomato passata for 8–10 minutes until quite thick, then cool completely. Chop the basil. Cut the mozzarella into small cubes and drain it on kitchen paper for at least 20 minutes; a watery filling can burst the pockets in hot oil.

Divide the risen dough into eight equal balls. Roll each on a lightly floured surface to a round about 14–15 cm wide, slightly thinner at the edge. Put about 1 tablespoon of cooled tomato, one-eighth of the dry mozzarella and a little basil in the centre of each round. Sprinkle with oregano; leave a 2 cm clean border and do not overfill.

Fold each round into a half-moon. Press out excess air and pinch the edges tightly, then seal with the tines of a fork. Assemble only as many as can be fried promptly. Heat the neutral oil in a deep, heavy pan to 175–180°C; keep children clear and do not fill the pan beyond halfway.

Fry two panzerotti at a time for 3–4 minutes, turning carefully, until puffed and evenly golden. Keep the oil near 175–180°C between batches. Lift onto a rack or paper to drain for 2 minutes. Serve warm while the crust is crisp and the tomato-mozzarella centre is molten.
tips: Use cool, thick tomato and well-drained cheese, and seal every edge before frying. The reviewed image shows small golden fried half-moons, one opened to reveal red tomato and white melted cheese; it is distinct from an oven-baked calzone.

hi.Fold each round into a half-moon. Press: हर गोले को मोड़कर आधा चाँद बनाएँ। अतिरिक्त हवा निकालकर किनारे अच्छी तरह दबाएँ, फिर काँटे के दाँतों से सील करें। उतने ही तैयार करें जितने तुरंत तल सकें। गहरे, भारी पैन में तेल 175–180°C तक गरम करें; बच्चों को दूर रखें और पैन आधे से ज़्यादा न भरें।

recipe.name: Bean Burrito

ingredients.name: cooked pinto or black beans, drained
red and yellow bell peppers, diced
vegetarian melting cheese made with vegetarian coagulants, grated

steps: Drain the cooked beans well. Heat 10 ml oil in a wide pan, cook the onion and diced peppers for 5–6 minutes until just softened, then stir in cumin and chilli powder for 30 seconds. Add the beans and half the salt; cook 3–4 minutes, lightly mashing a quarter of the beans so the filling holds together. Keep the mixture moist but not watery.

Warm the cooked rice with the remaining salt, lime juice and half the chopped coriander. Warm the thick salsa separately if desired. Check the cheese label to ensure it contains no animal-derived coagulants. Set out four large tortillas, the beans, rice, peppers, salsa and grated cheese before assembling.

Warm each tortilla briefly in a dry pan, 15–20 seconds per side, until flexible. Place one-quarter of the rice in a short strip just below the centre, then add one-quarter of the bean-pepper mixture, 30 g salsa, 30 g cheese and a little of the remaining coriander. Leave generous empty space at both sides and do not overfill.

Fold the short sides inward over the filling. Lift the bottom edge over it, tuck firmly, and roll away from you into a tight, fully closed cylinder. Repeat for all four burritos, placing each seam-side down. If a tortilla cracks, warm it a little longer before rolling.

Heat the remaining 5 ml oil in a non-stick pan over medium heat. Toast the burritos seam-side down for 2–3 minutes, turn and toast the other side for 2 minutes, until lightly browned and the cheese melts. Rest for 2 minutes and cut diagonally; serve with any extra salsa and lime.
tips: Use cooked beans and cooked rice; raw weights would require different cooking times. The reviewed photo shows sliced toasted burritos with distinct beans, rice, peppers, tomato and cheese. Keep salsa thick so the tortilla does not become soggy.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

dish.name: Vegetarian Chimichanga
ingredients: vegetarian melting cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

recipe.name: Vegetarian Chimichanga

ingredients.name: vegetarian melting cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Drain the cooked black beans and sweetcorn thoroughly. Heat 10 ml of the measured oil in a pan and cook onion and red pepper for 5 minutes until softened. Add cumin and smoked paprika for 30 seconds, then stir in beans, corn, cooked rice and salt. Cook 3 minutes until hot and fairly dry; cool for 10 minutes so the tortillas do not steam open.

Check the cheese label to ensure it contains no animal-derived coagulants. Stir the chopped coriander into the cooled filling. Briefly warm the four tortillas in a dry pan so they bend without cracking. Put one-quarter of the filling slightly below the centre of each tortilla, then add 35 g cheese and 25 g thick salsa. Leave a generous clear border.

Fold the left and right edges in over the filling, pull the near edge tightly across it, and roll into a sealed rectangular parcel. Place seam-side down. If necessary, secure with a wooden toothpick and remember to remove it before serving. Keep the salsa inside thick; liquid can cause dangerous spattering during frying.

Pour the remaining oil into a deep heavy pan, keeping it no more than half full, and heat to 175°C. Carefully lower in one or two parcels seam-side down; fry for 3–5 minutes, turning gently until all sides are crisp golden brown and the filling is hot. Return the oil to 175°C between batches.

Drain on a rack for 3 minutes and remove any toothpicks. Cut one chimichanga diagonally to check that the cheese has melted, then serve the four hot parcels with avocado slices and extra salsa if desired. The fried shell should be audibly crisp, unlike a soft burrito.
tips: This is a fried, tightly sealed tortilla parcel, not another name for a soft burrito. The reviewed image shows a crisp bubbled shell and beans, corn, rice, peppers and cheese in the cut centre. Keep both the filling and salsa fairly dry before frying.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Check the cheese label to ensure it cont: चीज़ के लेबल पर जाँचें कि उसमें पशु रेननेट नहीं है। ठंडी भरावन में कटा धनिया मिलाएँ। चार टॉर्टिया सूखे पैन में थोड़ी गरम करें ताकि बिना फटे मुड़ें। हर टॉर्टिया पर बीच से थोड़ा नीचे चौथाई भरावन रखें, फिर 35 ग्राम चीज़ और 25 ग्राम गाढ़ा साल्सा डालें। किनारों पर पर्याप्त जगह छोड़ें।
hi.Fold the left and right edges in over th: बायाँ और दायाँ किनारा भरावन पर मोड़ें, पास वाला किनारा कसकर ऊपर खींचें और बंद आयताकार पैकेट की तरह लपेटें। जोड़ नीचे रखें। ज़रूरत हो तो लकड़ी की टूथपिक लगाएँ और परोसने से पहले निकालना याद रखें। भीतर का साल्सा गाढ़ा रखें; पतला साल्सा तलते समय तेल उछाल सकता है।

hi.This is a fried, tightly sealed tortilla: यह तला, कसकर बंद टॉर्टिया पैकेट है, नरम बरिटो का दूसरा नाम नहीं। समीक्षित तस्वीर में बुलबुलों वाली कुरकुरी पपड़ी और कटे बीच में बीन्स, मकई, चावल, शिमला मिर्च तथा चीज़ हैं। तलने से पहले भरावन और साल्सा काफ़ी सूखे रखें।

dish.name: Vegetarian Sopes
ingredients: vegetarian crumbly fresh cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

recipe.name: Vegetarian Sopes

ingredients.name: vegetarian crumbly fresh cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Mix masa harina with salt, then add the warm water gradually and knead for 2 minutes into a soft dough that holds together without sticking. Rest covered for 15 minutes so the corn flour hydrates. If the dough cracks when pressed, work in a little of the measured water; if sticky, rest a little longer.

Divide the dough into eight equal balls. Flatten each between two sheets of plastic or baking paper into a thick round about 9–10 cm across and 8–10 mm thick. Heat a dry heavy griddle over medium heat and cook each round for about 2 minutes per side until the surface sets and light brown marks appear.

While the rounds are still warm but safe to handle, use a clean cloth to protect your fingers and pinch a raised rim all the way around each edge, making a shallow bowl. Brush the griddle lightly with the measured oil and return the shaped sopes, base-side down, for 2–3 minutes until their bottoms are lightly crisp and the centres cook through.

Warm the vegetarian refried beans until spreadable. Verify that the crumbly cheese is made with vegetarian coagulants. Spread about 40 g beans inside each raised rim, then divide the shredded lettuce and thick tomato salsa evenly among the eight sopes. Add the cheese, a spoonful of crema and chopped coriander to each.

Serve immediately, two sopes per person, while the thick corn bases are warm and the lettuce remains crisp. Lift them by their firm raised edges; these are open topped masa cakes, not folded tacos or flat crisp tostadas.
tips: Masa harina is nixtamalized corn flour; ordinary coarse cornmeal will not form the same smooth dough. Pinch the rim while warm, before the masa becomes rigid. The reviewed photo clearly shows four thick, raised-rim corn cakes with beans, lettuce, tomato, white cheese and crema.

dish.name: Bean and Poblano Gorditas
ingredients: roasted poblano or green bell pepper strips
vegetarian crumbly fresh cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

recipe.name: Bean and Poblano Gorditas

ingredients.name: roasted poblano or green bell pepper strips
vegetarian crumbly fresh cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Stir the salt into the masa harina. Gradually add 360 ml warm water and knead for 2–3 minutes until a soft, cohesive dough forms. Reserve the remaining 30 ml for adjusting if it cracks. Cover and rest 15 minutes so the masa hydrates.

Meanwhile heat 10 ml oil in a pan. Cook the chopped onion for 3 minutes, add cumin for 30 seconds, then add the drained cooked black beans. Mash about half the beans and cook for 4–5 minutes until thick enough to stay in a pocket. Pat the roasted pepper strips dry and chop the coriander. Check that the fresh cheese uses no animal-derived coagulants.

Divide the dough into eight equal balls. Press each between sheets of plastic into a thick round about 10 cm across and 12 mm thick. Smooth any cracks with a damp finger. Heat a heavy griddle over medium heat and cook the rounds for 4–5 minutes on each side until browned in places and fully cooked through; their thickness matters for making pockets.

Rest each cooked round for about a minute, then carefully cut a slit along one side and open an internal pocket with a small knife, leaving the other side joined. If the centre is still raw, put it back on the griddle briefly. Brush the outside of the gorditas with the remaining 15 ml oil and toast each side for 1 minute for a lightly crisp surface.

Spoon about 40 g of the warm bean mixture into each pocket, followed by roasted pepper strips, crumbled vegetarian cheese and coriander. Serve two gorditas per person with tomato salsa on the side. The filling belongs inside the split thick corn cake, unlike the toppings on an open sope.
tips: Do not flatten the masa as thin as a tortilla: the cooked cake must be thick enough to split. Keep the beans thick and peppers dry so the pocket does not tear. The reviewed photo shows several substantial side-split corn pockets with beans, green pepper strips and white cheese.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.Meanwhile heat 10 ml oil in a pan. Cook: દરમિયાન કડાઈમાં 10 મિલી તેલ ગરમ કરો. સમારેલી ડુંગળી 3 મિનિટ રાંધો, જીરું 30 સેકન્ડ સાંતળો, પછી રાંધેલા નિતારેલા કાળા બીન નાખો. લગભગ અડધા બીન છૂંદી 4–5 મિનિટ રાંધો જેથી મિશ્રણ ખિસ્સામાં ટકે એટલું ઘાટું થાય. શેકેલા મરચાંની પટ્ટીઓ કોરી કરો અને કોથમીર સમારો. તાજા ચીઝમાં પ્રાણીજન્ય રેનેટ નથી તે તપાસો.
લોટના આઠ સરખા ગોળા કરો. દરેકને પ્લાસ્ટિકનાં પડ વચ્ચે દબાવી આશરે 10 સેમી પહોળી અને 12 મિમી જાડી ગોળ રોટલી બનાવો. તિરાડો ભીની આંગળીથી સરખી કરો. ભારે તવો મધ્યમ તાપે ગરમ કરો અને બંને બાજુ 4–5 મિનિટ શેકો જેથી ક્યાંક ક્યાંક બદામી અને અંદર સુધી રંધાય; ખિસ્સો બનાવવા જાડાઈ જરૂરી છે.
gu.Rest each cooked round for about a minut: દરેક શેકેલી રોટલીને આશરે એક મિનિટ આરામ આપો, પછી એક બાજુ ચીરો કરી નાની છરીથી અંદર ખિસ્સો ખોલો અને બીજી બાજુ જોડાયેલી રાખો. મધ્ય ભાગ કાચો હોય તો ફરી તવા પર થોડો સમય શેકો. બાકીનું 15 મિલી તેલ ગોર્ડિટાસની બહાર લગાવો અને બંને બાજુ 1 મિનિટ શેકો જેથી સપાટી સહેજ કરકરી થાય.
gu.Spoon about 40 g of the warm bean mixtur: દરેક ખિસ્સામાં આશરે 40 ગ્રામ ગરમ બીન મિશ્રણ, પછી શેકેલા મરચાંની પટ્ટીઓ, ભૂકો કરેલું શાકાહારી ચીઝ અને કોથમીર ભરો. વ્યક્તિ દીઠ બે ગોર્ડિટાસ ટામેટાંની સાલસા સાથે પીરસો. પૂરણ જાડા ચીરેલા મકાઈના કેકની અંદર રહે છે, ખુલ્લા સોપેની ઉપર નહીં.
gu.Do not flatten the masa as thin as a tor: મકાઈની રોટલી ટોર્ટિયા જેટલી પાતળી ન દબાવો: શેકેલા કેકમાં ખિસ્સો ખોલી શકાય એટલી જાડાઈ હોવી જોઈએ. બીન ઘાટા અને મરચાં કોરાં રાખો જેથી ખિસ્સો ન ફાટે. તપાસેલા ફોટામાં ઘણા જાડા બાજુથી ખુલેલા મકાઈના ખિસ્સા છે, જેમાં બીન, લીલા મરચાંની પટ્ટીઓ અને સફેદ ચીઝ છે.

dish.name: Vegetarian Chalupas Poblanas
ingredients: vegetarian fresh white cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

recipe.name: Vegetarian Chalupas Poblanas

ingredients.name: vegetarian fresh white cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Combine masa harina and 3 g of the salt. Gradually work in the warm water to make a soft dough that does not crack when pressed. Cover and rest for 15 minutes. Meanwhile cook and cool the potato if it is not already prepared; cut it into small dice. Check that the white cheese is made with vegetarian coagulants.

Divide the dough into twelve small balls. Press each between sheets of plastic into a thin oval about 10 × 6 cm. Gently pinch the long sides up just enough to make a shallow boat shape, leaving the centre flat. Keep the ovals covered with a damp cloth while shaping the remainder.

Heat a wide heavy pan over medium heat with a thin layer of the measured neutral oil. Shallow-fry the ovals in batches for about 1–2 minutes per side until set and lightly golden, replenishing the measured oil as needed. Keep the shells slightly pliable rather than frying them into brittle tostadas; drain briefly on a rack.

Warm the green and red salsas separately until hot and season the diced potato with the remaining 2 g salt. Spread one tablespoon of green salsa on six warm chalupas and one tablespoon of red salsa on the other six. Divide the cooked potato, finely diced white onion and crumbled vegetarian cheese evenly over the twelve.

Serve immediately, three small chalupas per person. Alternate the red and green versions on a platter so the thin oval masa boats and modest toppings are visible. This Puebla-style preparation is intentionally smaller and flatter than a thick, loaded, round sope.
tips: Use vegetable oil rather than lard and verify the cheese label. Both salsas must be thick so they sit on the small oval bases. The reviewed photo shows six thin oval boats alternating red and green salsa with potato, white onion and cheese.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.masa harina (nixtamalized corn flour): मासा हारिना (क्षार से संसाधित मक्के का आटा)
hi.neutral oil for shallow frying: हल्का तलने के लिए हल्का स्वाद वाला तेल
hi.vegetarian fresh white cheese made with: पशु रेननेट रहित शाकाहारी ताज़ा सफेद चीज़
मासा हारिना में 3 ग्राम नमक मिलाएँ। गुनगुना पानी धीरे-धीरे डालकर ऐसा नरम आटा बनाएँ जो दबाने पर फटे नहीं। ढककर 15 मिनट छोड़ें। इस बीच आलू पहले से न पका हो तो पकाकर ठंडा करें; छोटे टुकड़े काटें। जाँचें कि सफेद चीज़ पशु रेननेट के बिना बना है।
hi.Divide the dough into twelve small balls: आटे की बारह छोटी लोइयाँ बनाएँ। हर लोई को प्लास्टिक की परतों के बीच दबाकर लगभग 10 × 6 सेमी पतला अंडाकार बनाएँ। लंबी धारों को हल्का ऊपर चुटकी से उठाएँ ताकि उथली नाव बने, बीच सपाट रखें। बाकी बनाते समय बने अंडाकार नम कपड़े से ढकें।
hi.Heat a wide heavy pan over medium heat w: चौड़ा भारी पैन मध्यम आँच पर नापे तेल की पतली परत के साथ गरम करें। अंडाकारों को बैच में दोनों ओर करीब 1–2 मिनट हल्का तलें, जब तक जमकर हल्के सुनहरे हों; ज़रूरत पर नापे तेल में से और डालें। पूरी तरह भुरभुरे टोस्टाडा बनाने की बजाय थोड़ा लचीला रखें; जाली पर थोड़ी देर तेल टपकाएँ।
hi.Warm the green and red salsas separately: हरे और लाल साल्सा को अलग-अलग गरम करें और कटे आलू में बचा 2 ग्राम नमक मिलाएँ। छह गरम चालुपास पर एक-एक बड़ा चम्मच हरा साल्सा और बाकी छह पर लाल साल्सा लगाएँ। पका आलू, बारीक सफेद प्याज़ और चूरा शाकाहारी चीज़ बारहों पर बराबर बाँटें।
hi.Serve immediately, three small chalupas: तुरंत परोसें, प्रति व्यक्ति तीन छोटी चालुपास। थाल में लाल और हरी बारी-बारी रखें ताकि पतले अंडाकार मक्के के आधार और हल्की टॉपिंग दिखें। पोब्ला शैली का यह रूप मोटे, भरे हुए गोल सोपे से जानबूझकर छोटा और चपटा होता है।
hi.Use vegetable oil rather than lard and v: लार्ड की जगह वनस्पति तेल लें और चीज़ का लेबल जाँचें। दोनों साल्सा गाढ़े हों ताकि छोटे अंडाकार आधार पर टिकें। समीक्षित तस्वीर में छह पतली अंडाकार नावें हैं, बारी-बारी लाल-हरा साल्सा और ऊपर आलू, सफेद प्याज़ व चीज़ है।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.masa harina (nixtamalized corn flour): માસા હારિના (ક્ષારથી પ્રક્રિયા કરેલો મકાઈનો લોટ)
gu.neutral oil for shallow frying: છીછરું તળવા માટે હળવા સ્વાદનું તેલ
gu.vegetarian fresh white cheese made with: પ્રાણીજન્ય રેનેટ વગરનું શાકાહારી તાજું સફેદ ચીઝ
માસા હારિનામાં 3 ગ્રામ મીઠું ભેળવો. હૂંફાળું પાણી ધીમે ધીમે નાખી એવો નરમ લોટ બનાવો જે દબાવતાં ફાટે નહીં. ઢાંકી 15 મિનિટ રાખો. દરમિયાન બટાકા અગાઉથી રાંધેલા ન હોય તો રાંધી ઠંડા કરો; નાના કટકા કરો. સફેદ ચીઝ પ્રાણીજન્ય રેનેટ વગર બન્યું છે તે તપાસો.
gu.Divide the dough into twelve small balls: લોટના બાર નાના ગોળા કરો. દરેકને પ્લાસ્ટિકનાં પડ વચ્ચે દબાવી આશરે 10 × 6 સેમી પાતળો લંબગોળ બનાવો. લાંબી ધાર સહેજ ચપટીથી ઊંચી કરો જેથી છીછરી નાવ બને, મધ્ય ભાગ સપાટ રાખો. બાકીના બનાવતાં તૈયાર લંબગોળને ભીના કપડાથી ઢાંકો.
gu.Heat a wide heavy pan over medium heat w: પહોળી ભારે કડાઈ મધ્યમ તાપે માપેલા તેલની પાતળી પરત સાથે ગરમ કરો. લંબગોળને ખેપમાં બંને બાજુ આશરે 1–2 મિનિટ છીછરા તેલમાં તળો જેથી સ્થિર અને આછા સોનેરી થાય; જરૂર મુજબ માપેલા તેલમાંથી વધારો. સાવ ભાંગી જાય એવા ટોસ્ટાડા ન બનાવતાં સહેજ લચીલા રાખો; જાળી પર થોડું તેલ નિતારો.
gu.Warm the green and red salsas separately: લીલી અને લાલ સાલસા અલગ ગરમ કરો અને કાપેલા બટાકામાં બાકીનું 2 ગ્રામ મીઠું ભેળવો. છ ગરમ ચાલુપાસ પર એક-એક મોટી ચમચી લીલી સાલસા અને અન્ય છ પર લાલ સાલસા લગાવો. રાંધેલા બટાકા, ઝીણી સફેદ ડુંગળી અને ભૂકો કરેલું શાકાહારી ચીઝ બારેય પર સરખાં વહેંચો.
gu.Serve immediately, three small chalupas: તરત પીરસો, દરેકને ત્રણ નાની ચાલુપાસ. થાળીમાં લાલ અને લીલી વારાફરતી ગોઠવો જેથી પાતળી લંબગોળ મકાઈની નાવ અને હળવું પૂરણ દેખાય. પોબ્લા શૈલીનું આ રૂપ જાડા, ભરેલા ગોળ સોપે કરતાં જાણીજોઈને નાનું અને સપાટ હોય છે.
gu.Use vegetable oil rather than lard and v: પ્રાણીની ચરબીને બદલે વનસ્પતિ તેલ વાપરો અને ચીઝનું લેબલ તપાસો. બંને સાલસા ઘાટી હોવી જોઈએ જેથી નાનાં લંબગોળ પાયા પર ટકે. તપાસેલા ફોટામાં છ પાતળી લંબગોળ નાવ છે, વારાફરતી લાલ-લીલી સાલસા અને ઉપર બટાકા, સફેદ ડુંગળી તથા ચીઝ છે.

dish.name: Bean and Nopales Huaraches
ingredients: vegetarian fresh white cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

recipe.name: Bean and Nopales Huaraches

ingredients.name: vegetarian fresh white cheese made with vegetarian coagulants

steps: Mix masa harina with salt, then gradually knead in 390 ml warm water until the dough is soft, cohesive and free of large cracks. Reserve 20 ml water for adjusting if dry. Cover and rest 15 minutes. Mash the cooked beans into a thick, spreadable paste; drain the cooked nopales well so their surface is not slippery.

Divide the dough into four equal portions. Roll each portion into a long oval, roughly 20 × 9 cm and about 1 cm thick, between two sheets of plastic or baking paper. Smooth cracked edges with a damp finger. Keep the sandal-like shape long and narrow; a round disc would resemble a sope instead.

Heat a heavy griddle over medium heat and cook each masa oval for 5–6 minutes per side until browned in spots and cooked through. Brush the bases with 15 ml oil in total and return them to the griddle for another 1 minute per side to make the outside lightly crisp while the centre stays tender.

Heat the remaining 10 ml oil in a pan and sauté the drained nopales for 3–4 minutes until hot and any surface liquid evaporates. Warm the mashed pinto beans separately. Check that the cheese is made with vegetarian coagulants. Chop the white onion and coriander finely.

Spread about 90 g warm mashed beans over each hot long oval, leaving a visible border. Divide the cooked nopales, thick red salsa, crumbled vegetarian cheese, onion, coriander and crema among the four. Serve immediately, one huarache per person, while the masa remains warm and sturdy enough to hold the toppings.
tips: Use already cooked, drained nopales; raw cactus needs cleaning and a separate cooking step. The reviewed photo shows two unusually long, narrow corn bases under beans, green nopales, red salsa, white cheese and crema, visually distinct from round sopes and small chalupas.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.masa harina (nixtamalized corn flour): मासा हारिना (क्षार से संसाधित मक्के का आटा)
hi.cooked pinto beans, mashed thick: पके पिंटो बीन्स, गाढ़े मसले हुए
hi.cooked nopales cactus strips, drained: पकी नोपालेस कैक्टस की पट्टियाँ, पानी निकाली हुई

steps: Dice 80 g onion and the garlic; finely dice the remaining 60 g onion for garnish. Heat 10 ml oil in a saucepan and soften the first onion portion for 4 minutes. Add garlic and cumin for 30 seconds, then stir in the drained cooked black beans and vegetable stock. Simmer for 5 minutes.

Blend the bean mixture until completely smooth, then return it to the saucepan. Add the salt and simmer gently for 3–5 minutes until it forms a thick but pourable sauce; loosen with a splash of water if necessary. Keep warm over low heat. Check that the fresh cheese is made with vegetarian coagulants.

Brush a wide frying pan with the remaining 10 ml oil. Warm each corn tortilla for about 15–20 seconds per side so it becomes pliable without crisping. Keep the warmed tortillas under a clean cloth. Do not use them cold, as they may split when folded.

Using tongs, dip one warm tortilla at a time into the warm black-bean sauce to coat both sides. Transfer it to a plate, sprinkle a little of the cheese on one half and fold over. Repeat to make eight sauced, folded tortillas, arranging two on each serving plate. Spoon the remaining bean sauce over them.

Finish each plate with the finely diced raw onion, remaining crumbled vegetarian cheese, crema, coriander and avocado slices. Serve immediately while the tortillas are soft and the dark bean sauce is warm; the coating should be black-bean sauce, not tomato or chilli enchilada sauce.
tips: Blend beans until silky and keep the sauce loose enough to coat tortillas; a dry bean paste will tear them. The reviewed photo shows folded tortillas beneath glossy dark bean sauce with white cheese, onion, crema, coriander and avocado.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

gu.Finish each plate with the finely diced: દરેક થાળી પર ઝીણી કાચી ડુંગળી, બાકી ભૂકો કરેલું શાકાહારી ચીઝ, ક્રેમા, કોથમીર અને એવોકાડો ગોઠવો. ટોર્ટિયા નરમ અને ઘાટી બીનની સોસ ગરમ હોય ત્યારે તરત પીરસો; ઉપર કાળા બીનની સોસ હોવી જોઈએ, ટામેટાં કે મરચાંની એનચિલાડા સોસ નહીં.
gu.Blend beans until silky and keep the sau: બીનને રેશમી સુંવાળાં પીસો અને સોસ ટોર્ટિયા કોટ થાય એટલી પાતળી રાખો; સૂકો બીન પેસ્ટ તેમને ફાડી નાખશે. તપાસેલા ફોટામાં વાળેલી ટોર્ટિયા ચળકતી ઘાટી બીનની સોસ નીચે છે, ઉપર સફેદ ચીઝ, ડુંગળી, ક્રેમા, કોથમીર અને એવોકાડો છે.

dish.name: Vegetarian Budín Azteca
ingredients: roasted poblano or green bell pepper strips
vegetarian melting cheese made with vegetarian coagulants, grated

recipe.name: Vegetarian Budín Azteca

ingredients.name: roasted poblano or green bell pepper strips
vegetarian melting cheese made with vegetarian coagulants, grated

steps: Heat the oven to 190°C. Check that the grated cheese contains no animal-derived coagulants. Heat 15 ml oil in a wide pan and cook the sliced onion for 4 minutes. Add mushrooms and cook 6–7 minutes until their released liquid evaporates. Stir in the roasted pepper strips, drained sweetcorn and salt; cook 2 minutes and set aside.

Brush the remaining 10 ml oil over a frying pan. Warm the corn tortillas briefly on both sides until pliable, then cut each in half. Spread about 80 g salsa verde across the bottom of a roughly 20 × 25 cm baking dish. Arrange one-third of the tortilla halves in a single overlapping layer.

Top the first tortilla layer with half the vegetable mixture, about 110 g salsa, 50 g crema and 70 g cheese. Repeat with a second third of the tortillas and the remaining vegetables, then another 110 g salsa, 50 g crema and 70 g cheese. Place the remaining tortillas on top.

Spread the remaining salsa over the top tortillas, dot with the remaining 60 g crema and scatter over the remaining 100 g cheese. Cover loosely with foil and bake for 20 minutes. Remove the foil and bake another 10–15 minutes until bubbling and lightly browned at the edges.

Rest the casserole for 10 minutes so the stacked tortillas can be cut into tidy squares. Divide into four portions and finish with coriander. Each slice should show distinct corn-tortilla layers separated by green salsa, poblano, corn and mushrooms beneath melted cheese.
tips: Use corn tortillas rather than pasta sheets, and cook mushroom moisture away before layering. The reviewed photo shows a baked rectangular casserole with visible tortilla, green salsa, mushroom, poblano, corn and cheese layers.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.roasted poblano or green bell pepper str: भुनी पोब्लानो या हरी शिमला मिर्च की पट्टियाँ
hi.sweetcorn kernels, drained: मीठे मकई के दाने, पानी निकाले हुए
hi.vegetarian melting cheese made with vege: पशु रेननेट रहित शाकाहारी पिघलने वाला चीज़, कद्दूकस
hi.Heat the oven to 190°C. Check that the g: ओवन 190°C पर गरम करें। जाँचें कि कद्दूकस चीज़ में पशु रेननेट नहीं है। चौड़े पैन में 15 मिली तेल गरम करें और कटा प्याज़ 4 मिनट पकाएँ। मशरूम डालकर 6–7 मिनट पकाएँ, जब तक उनका निकला पानी सूख जाए। भुनी मिर्च की पट्टियाँ, छाना मकई और नमक मिलाकर 2 मिनट पकाएँ, फिर अलग रखें।
hi.Brush the remaining 10 ml oil over a fry: बचा 10 मिली तेल तवे पर लगाएँ। मक्के की टॉर्टिया दोनों ओर थोड़ी गरम करके लचीली करें, फिर हर एक को आधा काटें। लगभग 20 × 25 सेमी बेकिंग डिश के तले में करीब 80 ग्राम हरा साल्सा फैलाएँ। टॉर्टिया के आधे टुकड़ों का एक-तिहाई हिस्सा थोड़ा चढ़ाकर एक परत में रखें।
hi.Top the first tortilla layer with half t: पहली टॉर्टिया परत पर आधी सब्ज़ी, करीब 110 ग्राम साल्सा, 50 ग्राम क्रेमा और 70 ग्राम चीज़ रखें। दूसरी एक-तिहाई टॉर्टिया और बची सब्ज़ी की परत बनाएँ, फिर 110 ग्राम साल्सा, 50 ग्राम क्रेमा और 70 ग्राम चीज़ डालें। ऊपर बची टॉर्टिया रखें।
hi.Spread the remaining salsa over the top: ऊपरी टॉर्टिया पर बचा साल्सा फैलाएँ, बचा 60 ग्राम क्रेमा जगह-जगह डालें और बचा 100 ग्राम चीज़ छिड़कें। फॉइल ढीला ढककर 20 मिनट बेक करें। फॉइल हटाकर 10–15 मिनट और बेक करें, जब तक बुलबुले आएँ और किनारे हल्के भूरे हों।
hi.Rest the casserole for 10 minutes so the: कैसरोल को 10 मिनट ठहराएँ ताकि टॉर्टिया की परतें साफ़ चौकोर कटें। चार भाग करें और धनिया डालें। हर टुकड़े में पिघले चीज़ के नीचे हरे साल्सा, पोब्लानो, मकई और मशरूम से अलग हुई मक्के की टॉर्टिया परतें दिखनी चाहिए।
hi.Use corn tortillas rather than pasta she: पास्ता शीट नहीं, मक्के की टॉर्टिया लें और परत लगाने से पहले मशरूम का पानी सुखाएँ। समीक्षित तस्वीर में आयताकार पकी कैसरोल है, जिसकी टॉर्टिया, हरा साल्सा, मशरूम, पोब्लानो, मकई और चीज़ की परतें साफ़ दिखती हैं।

gu.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: માત્રા ચાર પુખ્ત વ્યક્તિઓ માટે છે. દરેક પગલામાં પાકવાના સંકેત તપાસો અને સ્વાદ પ્રમાણે મસાલો ગોઠવો. જૈન યોગ્યતા તમારા પરિવારના સામગ્રીના નિયમો પર આધારિત છે.
gu.roasted poblano or green bell pepper str: શેકેલા પોબ્લાનો અથવા લીલા સિમલા મરચાંની પટ્ટીઓ

gu.Heat the oven to 190°C. Check that the g: ઓવન 190°C પર ગરમ કરો. છીણેલા ચીઝમાં પ્રાણીજન્ય રેનેટ નથી તે તપાસો. પહોળી કડાઈમાં 15 મિલી તેલ ગરમ કરી પાતળી ડુંગળી 4 મિનિટ રાંધો. મશરૂમ નાખી 6–7 મિનિટ રાંધો જેથી તેમનું પાણી બળી જાય. શેકેલા મરચાંની પટ્ટીઓ, નિતારેલી મકાઈ અને મીઠું ભેળવી 2 મિનિટ રાંધો, પછી બાજુએ રાખો.

gu.Spread the remaining salsa over the top: ઉપરની ટોર્ટિયા પર બાકી સાલસા પાથરો, બાકી 60 ગ્રામ ક્રેમા થોડે થોડે મૂકો અને બાકી 100 ગ્રામ ચીઝ છાંટો. ઢીલી ફોઇલ ઢાંકી 20 મિનિટ બેક કરો. ફોઇલ દૂર કરી 10–15 મિનિટ વધુ બેક કરો જેથી પરપોટા આવે અને ધાર આછી બદામી થાય.
gu.Rest the casserole for 10 minutes so the: કેસરોલને 10 મિનિટ આરામ આપો જેથી ટોર્ટિયાની પરતો ચોખ્ખા ચોરસ કપાય. ચાર ભાગ કરો અને કોથમીર નાખો. દરેક ટુકડામાં ઓગળેલા ચીઝ નીચે લીલી સાલસા, પોબ્લાનો, મકાઈ અને મશરૂમ વચ્ચે મકાઈની ટોર્ટિયાની અલગ પરતો દેખાવા જોઈએ.

dish.name: Vegetable Pasty
ingredients: swede or turnip, peeled and finely diced

recipe.name: Vegetable Pasty

ingredients.name: swede or turnip, peeled and finely diced

steps: Rub the cold cubed butter into the flour with your fingertips until coarse crumbs form. Mix in 4 g of the salt, then add the cold water a little at a time just until the dough holds together. Do not overwork it. Divide into four discs, wrap and chill for at least 30 minutes.

Cut the potato, swede, carrot and onion into small, roughly 5 mm dice so they cook through inside the pastry. Combine with green peas, the remaining 4 g salt and black pepper. Keep the filling raw and dry; drain thawed peas if using frozen ones.

Heat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray. Roll each chilled pastry disc into a circle about 20 cm wide and 3 mm thick. Divide the vegetable filling among one half of each circle, leaving a 2 cm border. Brush the border lightly with a little water, fold the empty half over and press into a D shape.

Crimp the curved edge firmly by folding and pressing small sections over one another. Put the four sealed pasties on the tray, cut a small steam vent in each top, and brush all exposed pastry with milk for an eggless finish. Chill for 10 minutes if the pastry has become soft.

Bake for 40–45 minutes until the crust is deeply golden and crisp and the potato and swede are tender when tested through a vent. If the crust colours too quickly, reduce the oven to 180°C for the final 10 minutes. Rest 10 minutes before serving; the vegetable filling will be very hot.
tips: This is a vegetable pasty, not a protected traditional Cornish pasty. Small, even vegetable dice are essential for cooking raw filling inside the folded pastry. The reviewed photo shows browned hand-crimped D-shaped pasties, one opened to reveal potato, swede, carrot, peas and onion.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.

hi.Quantities serve four adults. Check the: मात्राएँ चार वयस्कों के लिए हैं। हर चरण में पकने के संकेत जाँचें और स्वाद के अनुसार मसाला बदलें। जैन उपयुक्तता आपके परिवार की सामग्री संबंधी नियमों पर निर्भर है।
hi.cold unsalted butter, cubed: ठंडा बिना नमक का मक्खन, टुकड़ों में
hi.swede or turnip, peeled and finely diced: स्वीड या शलजम, छिला और बारीक कटा
hi.Rub the cold cubed butter into the flour: ठंडे मक्खन को मैदे में उँगलियों से रगड़ें, जब तक मोटे चूरे जैसा हो। 4 ग्राम नमक मिलाएँ, फिर ठंडा पानी थोड़ा-थोड़ा डालकर सिर्फ़ इतना जोड़ें कि आटा बँध जाए। अधिक न गूँधें। चार चपटे गोले बनाकर लपेटें और कम से कम 30 मिनट ठंडा करें।

dish.name: Cheese and Onion Pie
ingredients: vegetarian mature cheddar-style cheese made with vegetarian coagulants, grated

recipe.name: Cheese and Onion Pie

ingredients.name: vegetarian mature cheddar-style cheese made with vegetarian coagulants, grated

steps: Rub the cold butter into the flour until coarse crumbs form. Stir in 4 g salt and add cold water gradually, mixing just until the dough comes together. Divide about two-thirds for the base and one-third for the lid. Flatten, wrap and chill both pieces for 30 minutes.

Meanwhile heat the neutral oil in a wide pan over medium-low heat. Cook the thinly sliced onions with the remaining 3 g salt for 25–30 minutes, stirring often, until soft, sweet and most moisture has evaporated. Stir in mustard, thyme and black pepper, then cool completely. Check the cheese label to ensure it contains no animal-derived coagulants.

Heat the oven to 200°C. Roll the larger chilled dough piece into a round big enough to line a 22 cm pie dish with overhang. Press it gently into the dish. Spread half the cooled onions in the base, add half the grated vegetarian cheese, then repeat the onion and cheese layers. Keep the filling below the rim.

Roll the smaller dough piece into a lid. Brush the exposed base edge with a little milk, place the lid on top, press to seal and crimp around the rim. Cut two small steam vents and brush the lid with the remaining milk for an eggless golden finish. Chill for 10 minutes if the pastry has softened.

Bake for 35–40 minutes until the pastry is deep golden and crisp and the cheese bubbles at the vents. Rest for at least 15 minutes before cutting into four wedges, so the soft onion-cheese filling holds its shape. Serve warm with a simple salad.
tips: Cool the onions fully before they touch the pastry; hot or watery onion makes a soggy base. Use cheese explicitly made with vegetarian or microbial rennet. The reviewed photo shows a round lidded pie and a cut wedge filled mainly with tender onion and melted pale cheese, without potato.
recipe.notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
